name: waypoint
description: Waypoint agent plugin. Add this repository as a marketplace (local path, private or public GitHub) and install "waypoint" from the Discover tab.

plugins.name: waypoint
plugins.description: Attaches harness telemetry (agent, model, host, branch, changed files) to Waypoint run claims, checkpoints and completions, suspends the agent while a blocking decision waits for the operator, and parks an idle agent in the Waypoint queue until the operator sends it work. Pair with the Waypoint MCP server from claude mcp add.
